turns.text: Should I rent, buy, or API an H100 for Llama-3-70B at 50 rps for 3 years?

**TL;DR: At Nov 2026 H100 rates with 512 input / 256 output tokens, the per-token inference API wins at $2.64/M output tokens — 2.45× cheaper than on-demand hyperscaler, 1.36× cheaper than neocloud ($3.60/M).** Owning (3y depreciation) and 3y reserved are essentially tied at ~$3.77/M, both well above the API.

Workload sized at ~50 rps. The GPU-based options include **prefill time amortised** into the output-token cost (F4 fix), so this comparison is fair against the API which already prices input tokens. The real GTM question for a neocloud: at what utilisation does rental beat the API? Under this 60% busy scenario the API wins; push busy higher or drop input-token share and neocloud crosses under.

Prices used: neocloud $3.06/hr (Ornn Compute Price Index, settled 15 Nov 2026), reserved $3.20/hr, on-demand $5.50/hr. All marked ⚪ assumption — tune on the *What does it cost* page.

result.note: 70B FP16 needs model-parallel across 2+ H100s; sized below for an 8-GPU cluster.
Neocloud rental beats the per-token API once you're decoding more than ~82% of paid hours. Below that the API is cheaper. This is the question that matters for the neocloud sales call.
